summary: The coordinate transformations and area normalization are correct; the triangle, sign-cell, and truncated-simplex area formulas follow from direct determinant and section computations. The right derivative of the actual lower-crossing function is computed with the correct signs and scale factors, the infimum condition supplies a strictly lower value arbitrarily close on the right, and this forces the derivative to be nonpositive. The resulting strict bound p/m<2 is valid and contradicts the assumed p/m>beta because beta>2.
